name: Lung
source:
He borrowed money from his aunt, Madam Fen, to start an entertainment agency called TMall PR Corp. 
But it quickly collapsed due to his wild management that put most of the money he earned into gambling.
The agency closed down after the death of Yanyan, a model who had stayed on with the company, and he went to work for Shrewd Lou, who had helped him out.
At Shrewd Lou's request, he framed Yam Keung, a classmate from elementary school, for assassination of Francis.
As a result, Lung was hunted by the Red Flower Society.
